trick: Self-review the diff: one more turn to check its own work
source_note: Season 2 lineup (19 Oct, Receipt/speed; was day 43 in the 15 Sep plan). With: the task, then a second turn in the SAME session (resumed): 'Now review your own diff for bugs and fix any you find.' Without: the task alone. The 20-minute cap covers both turns on the with side; time, cost and tokens are summed over both (as on days 11-19). Both sides carry the same Stop hook (overlay ../d42/snap: records the repo state after each call, never blocks, prints nothing); ../d42/check_step1.py grades the state after the first call, so with-side rows say whether the review turn turned a failing run into a passing one (or broke a passing one). Standard verdict rule. Pre-registered count (tricks/d42/count_steps.py d44): with-side runs whose first call failed the hidden tests and whose end state passed (fixed by the review turn), and the reverse (broken by it); plus cost and minutes per passed task on both sides (E6).
tasks_note: Fixed 23 Oct by the E1 pilot (PROTOCOL 2026-10-23 pilot entry): t2 and h2 on Haiku 4.5.
behaviour_count: With-side runs where the review turn fixed a hidden-test failure (first call failed, end passed) vs broke a pass (first call passed, end failed); cost per passed task on both sides
anchor: The review turn fixed N of 12 runs and broke M; each pass cost $X vs $Y
